title: Kagamine Rin — The Girl From The Album〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Kanade and the others are probably all working on the song that made Mafuyu smile right now...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'll go see what Miku's up to.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Rin... Can I help you?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Not really. I'm bored is all...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Would you like to sit with me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like you're always waiting in the same spot, Miku. Is it so Mafuyu can come here whenever she likes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But she hasn't been here lately.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The song and school have kept her busy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sure, but...
You're okay with that...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Before, she came here every day. She was in so much pain, but all I could do was sit next to her and watch.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then she discovered her true feelings with Kanade and the others, which seems to have helped her quite a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She used to come here because she was in pain, as if to escape it, but how she comes to visit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, I think she's in a much better place now...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But Mizuki is starting to worry me...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Mizuki's been coming here all alone lately.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I could so say, Hi, and... Oh...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(What's MEIKO up to?
Observing again, I guess...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Perfect timing. I was just getting bored and looking for someone to talk to...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm? Why do you want to sit back-to-back, Rin? Can't we just sit together like normal?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because you always start playing with my hair when we do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. If you don't want me to, you know you can just say so, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: MEIKO upped and left after watching me or something, and now you, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Just people watching as usual I'm guessing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, Rin, what brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I was wandering around and just happened to run into you, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you want to me leave you alone, like MEIKO did...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, didn't I just tell you that I was looking for someone to talk to?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wanna start by sitting next to me like normal? It's gonna be hard to have a real conversation if we're like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I found this corsage that I thought would suit you a while back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want you to try it on, so I'll make sure to bring it next time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I know you just want to use me as your dress-up doll.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I don't know what's bothering Mizuki but...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (But if it means not having to see that frown, maybe I should just play along.)
